name: Assurance Of Salvation
overview: The assurance of salvation is grounded in genuine faith in Jesus Christ, as Scripture teaches that those who believe in the Son have everlasting life and have passed from death to life, avoiding condemnation (John 3:16; John 3:36; John 5:24). However, Jesus warns that mere verbal profession is insufficient for entering the kingdom of heaven; doing the will of the Father and continuing in His word are marks of true discipleship (Matthew 7:21; John 8:31). Believers must also be vigilant against deception by false prophets, emphasizing the need for discernment in maintaining assurance (Matthew 24:11).
